npk_info:
🌱 NPK - Essential Plant Nutrients

🟢 Nitrogen (N)
• Leaf growth & green color
• Deficiency: Yellowing leaves
• Sources: Urea, Ammonium Sulfate

🔵 Phosphorus (P)
• Root development & flowering
• Deficiency: Purple leaves, poor roots
• Sources: DAP, SSP, Rock Phosphate

🔴 Potassium (K)
• Stem strength & disease resistance
• Deficiency: Brown leaf edges
• Sources: MOP, Potassium Sulfate

Ask me about specific fertilizers like 'Urea' or 'DAP'!
fertilizers:
💊 Common Fertilizers in India:

• Urea - 46% N (Top dressing)
• DAP - 18% N + 46% P (Basal)
• MOP - 60% K (Basal)
• SSP - 16% P + 11% S (Basal)
• Vermicompost - Organic (2.5-5 t/ha)
• FYM - Organic (10-20 t/ha)

Ask me about any specific fertilizer!
pesticides:
💊 Common Pesticides:

• Carbendazim - Fungicide for leaf spots
• Mancozeb - Broad-spectrum fungicide
• Chlorpyrifos - Soil insecticide
• Imidacloprid - Sucking pest control
• Neem Oil - Organic pesticide

Ask me about any specific pesticide!
soil_test:
🧪 Soil Testing

📋 Importance: Essential for balanced fertilization. Should be done every 2-3 years.
🔬 Sampling: Take 15-20 samples from different locations, mix thoroughly.
📊 Ideal pH: 6.0-7.5 for most crops
⏰ When: Before sowing season

🏛️ Government Scheme: Soil Health Card - Free soil testing every 2 years!
soil_types:
🪴 Major Soil Types in India

• Clay Soil: Heavy, water-retentive, rich in nutrients
• Loamy Soil: Ideal texture, balanced drainage
• Sandy Soil: Light, drains quickly, low nutrients
• Sandy Loam: Well-draining with some organic matter
• Black Cotton: Dark, clay-rich, high water holding
• Acidic Soil: pH below 6.0, needs lime treatment
• Red Soil: Iron-rich, well-draining
• Volcanic Soil: Very fertile, mineral-rich
• Well Drained: Good structure, easy water movement
• Alluvial Soil: River-deposited, very fertile
• Laterite Soil: Porous, tropical, low fertility

Ask me about any specific soil type like 'Clay soil' or 'Loamy soil'!
soil_ph:
📊 Soil pH Guide

• Below 5.5: Strongly Acidic - Add lime
• 5.5-6.0: Moderately Acidic - Tea, coffee
• 6.0-7.0: Slightly Acidic - IDEAL for most crops
• 7.0: Neutral - Perfect balance
• 7.0-8.0: Slightly Alkaline - Wheat, cotton
• Above 8.0: Strongly Alkaline - Add gypsum/sulfur

Ask about specific soil types for their pH ranges!
soil_health:
🌱 Improving Soil Health

✅ Add Organic Matter:
• Vermicompost: 2.5-5 tonnes/ha
• FYM: 10-20 tonnes/ha
• Green manure: Sunhemp, Dhaincha

✅ Crop Rotation:
• Cereal → Legume → Oilseed

✅ Mulching: Conserves moisture, adds nutrients

✅ Cover Crops: Protect soil between seasons

Ask about specific soil type for tailored advice!

kharif:
☀️ Kharif Season (June–October)

Sown at monsoon start. Harvested in autumn.

Major Crops: Rice, Maize, Cotton, Groundnut, Soybean, Millets, Jute, Turmeric

Soil: Clay, Loamy, Sandy, Black, Alluvial

States: All India (monsoon-dependent)
rabi:
❄️ Rabi Season (November–April)

Winter crops sown after monsoon. Harvested in spring.

Major Crops: Wheat, Barley, Mustard, Pulses, Potato, Onion, Cumin, Coriander

Soil: Loamy is ideal

States: Punjab, Haryana, UP, MP, Rajasthan
zaid:
🌤️ Zaid Season (April–June)

Off-season summer crops between Rabi and Kharif.

Major Crops: Sugarcane, Tea, Coffee, Watermelon, Muskmelon, Cucumber

Requires: Irrigation (low rainfall period)
